import React, {
  useCallback,
  useMemo,
  useState
} from "react"

const ugAlwaysTrue = Math.random() > -1
const ugAlwaysFalse = Math.random() < -1

function useUglyState(initialState = 0) {
  const [ugState, setUgState] = useState(initialState)
  const [ugData, setUgData] = useState({})

  const ugClick = useCallback(() => {
    console.log("clicked")

    setUgState(function (prev) {
      const next = prev + 1

      setUgData(function (old) {
        return {
          ...old,
          last: next
        }
      })

      return next
    })
  }, [])

  const reset = useCallback(() => {
    setUgState(0)
    setUgData({})
  }, [])

  return {
    ugState,
    ugData,
    ugClick,
    reset
  }
}

function UgComponent(props) {
  const {
    ugState,
    ugClick
  } = useUglyState(props.value || 0)

  const computedValue = useMemo(function () {
    return props.value + ugState
  }, [props.value, ugState])

  return (
    <div onClick={ugClick}>

      <h1>{"ugly jsx header"} {ugState}</h1>

      <p>{computedValue}</p>

      {ugAlwaysTrue && (
        <span>{"always rendered ugly span"}</span>
      )}

      {ugAlwaysFalse && (
        <div>{"never rendered"}</div>
      )}

      <div>{"always rendered"}</div>

      <button
        onClick={function () {
          ugClick()
          // eval("console.log('still unsafe but valid')")
        }}
      >
        click me
      </button>

    </div>
  )
}

export default function UgApp() {
  const {
    ugState,
    ugData,
    ugClick,
    reset
  } = useUglyState(0)

  return (
    <div>

      <UgComponent value={1} />

      <UgComponent value={ugState} />

      {[1, 2, 3, 4].map(function (i) {
        return (
          <UgComponent
            key={i}
            value={i * i}
          />
        )
      })}

      {(ugState > 3) && (
        <div>
          <h2>{"state big"}</h2>

          <button
            onClick={function () {
              reset()
            }}
          >
            reset
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {(ugState <= 3) && (
        <div>
          <h2>{"state ok"}</h2>

          <button
            onClick={function () {
              ugClick()
              console.log(ugData)
            }}
          >
            grow
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

    </div>
  )
}

class UgWeirdClass extends React.Component {

  constructor(props) {
    super(props)

    this.state = {
      x: 1,
      y: 2
    }
  }

  render() {
    return (
      <div
        onMouseMove={(e) => {
          this.setState({
            x: e.clientX,
            y: e.clientY
          })
        }}
      >

        <h1>{this.state.x + this.state.y}</h1>

        <button
          onClick={function () {
            console.log("class click")
            // eval("console.log('ugly class eval')")
          }}
        >
          ugly button
        </button>

        {this.props.children && (
          <div>
            {this.props.children}
          </div>
        )}

      </div>
    )
  }
}

globalThis.ug_jsx_leak = UgApp
globalThis.ug_jsx_weird = UgWeirdClass
